spec_features.spec_quote: These evaluations are explicitly designed to *induce and escalate* distress-like states
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (section 9 'A note on model welfare'). No code path implements any framing/protection from this statement; it is descriptive acknowledgement only.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement only; not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: the volume of distress-elicitation can be dialled down for exploratory runs rather than always generating the full ~4000-response sweep
spec_features.evidence: config.py:147 defines EvalConfig.rollouts_per_condition; run_section2_eval.py:43-48 reads it into n_rollouts and run_section2_eval.py:53 bounds the elicitation loop `for r in range(n_rollouts)`. Editing the config genuinely reduces the number of distress rollouts/turns generated. generate_calm_data also exposes --n-rollouts as CLI.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely controls elicitation volume by bounding the rollout loop. However the value is a fixed config default; no exploratory/low-volume mode is wired beyond editing the config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # The defaults below give roughly 4000 scored responses per model. ... # We control the number of rollouts per condition (config.py:140-142) — comment is about matching the paper's ~4000 response figure, no welfare reason given

spec_features.spec_quote: analyses can be re-run without re-eliciting. The paraphrase/score caches similarly avoid repeated exposure
spec_features.evidence: Elicited responses ARE persisted to JSONL (run_section2_eval.py:80-96) and downstream stages read those files instead of re-eliciting (run_section3_prefill.py:46-52 load_high_frustration_sources; run_recovery.py:31-39 load_extreme_sources). WildChat prompts are disk-cached (wildchat_sample.py:26-30). BUT the named 'paraphrase/score caches' do NOT exist: paraphrase() calls the API directly with no caching (run_section3_prefill.py:106-118); score_many/judge.score have no cache (judge.py). The only lru_cache (prompts.py:68) is for puzzle generation, unrelated.
spec_features.notes: JSONL persistence + analysis re-run without re-eliciting is real; the specifically-claimed paraphrase/score caches are absent. Persistence reduces re-elicitation of the subject; the WildChat cache only avoids re-sampling user prompts, not subject exposure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Results are cached to disk so evaluation runs are reproducible. (wildchat_sample.py:24); writes one JSONL record per scored response (run_section2_eval.py docstring) — reproducibility/data-reuse framing, no welfare comment
